# Docky 1.0.4
- Choose instant, short, relaxed, or deliberate hover opening in Appearance. - Click the island header to pin it open; click again or use its close control to collapse. Escape closes it when the island has keyboard focus. - The island stays open during file imports, outgoing drags, file selection, and Quick Look. - Preview shelf files with the eye button or click their name and press Space. Supported files use native macOS thumbnails. - Shelf results remain visible in the shelf even when island alerts are disabled. - New Permissions page brings Accessibility, keyboard listening, notification access, and live feature status together with macOS settings shortcuts. Checks do not request access automatically. - Settings navigation scrolls to keep every section accessible. - Publishing now runs native behavior checks before packaging.
## Validation
Native behavior checks cover file pasteboard formats, display placement, and each collapse-blocking interaction. Debug compilation and universal Release packaging are checked before publication. Real Finder dragging, Quick Look keyboard focus, permission changes in System Settings, and lock-screen behavior still need interactive validation on target Macs. No changes to macOS Mission Control gestures are made.
